plugins.name: 安静角落 · Cozy corner
plugins.author: Demiurge
plugins.description: 让角色更爱坐着、趴着看书听歌，说话轻声细语。适用于所有角色。Makes any character prefer sitting, lying down, reading and music, and speak softly.

plugins.name: 夜猫子 · Night owl
plugins.author: Demiurge
plugins.description: 精力充沛、爱玩游戏和吃零食的作息，跑来跑去，时不时找你玩。适用于所有角色。An energetic routine of games and snacks; she runs about and asks you to play.
